content.intro: This lesson covers File Integrity and Archiving in the PowerShell learning path. It expands the supplied syllabus heading into an actionable draft with a visual, a worked example, and a short knowledge check.
content.why_it_matters: Treat file and data processing as a pipeline: validate the source, parse into structured objects, transform, verify the shape and then write the result. Use explicit paths and encodings where portability matters, and test changes against temporary or synthetic data first.
